regulations.notes: Houston has no zoning code, making it one of the most permissive STR markets in the US. There is no citywide STR permit requirement or ban. Hosts must collect and remit hotel occupancy taxes to the state and city. Some neighborhoods may have deed restrictions or HOA rules that prohibit STRs. Texas state law (HB 3273, 2019) prevents municipalities from banning STRs outright.
